records.context: Prefer the current provider when old errors still permit reporting.
records.label: spacr.crashreport._dispatch_error.ai_eligible#0
records.source: Prefer the current provider when old errors still permit reporting.
records.translation: Den aktuellen Anbieter bevorzugen, wenn ältere Fehler weiterhin gemeldet werden dürfen.

records.context: Re-enter the existing policy/work list path once for this combined batch.
records.label: spacr.crashreport._dispatch_error.deliver#0
records.source: Re-enter the existing policy/queue path once for this combined batch.
records.translation: Für diesen zusammengefassten Stapel einmal erneut den vorhandenen Richtlinien-/Warteschlangenpfad durchlaufen.

records.context: Keep each pending entry within its original and current permission.
records.label: spacr.crashreport._dispatch_error.eligible#0
records.source: Keep each pending entry within its original and current permission.
records.translation: Jeden ausstehenden Eintrag innerhalb seiner ursprünglichen und seiner aktuellen Berechtigung halten.

records.context: A manual AI owner must not discard an already consented report.
records.label: spacr.crashreport._dispatch_error.report_eligible#0
records.source: A manual AI owner must not discard an already consented report.
records.translation: Ein manueller AI-Owner darf einen Bericht, dessen Versand bereits zugestimmt wurde, nicht verwerfen.

records.context: Sanitize the captured error and apply its AI and reporting policy.
records.label: spacr.crashreport._dispatch_error_now.work#0
records.source: Sanitize the captured error and apply its AI and reporting policy.
records.translation: Bereinige den erfassten Fehler und wende seine AI- und Melderichtlinie an.

records.context: Recheck revocation under the actual relay send lock.
records.label: spacr.crashreport._dispatch_error_now.work.allowed#0
records.source: Recheck revocation under the actual relay send lock.
records.translation: Prüfe den Widerruf erneut, während die tatsächliche Sperre für den Relay-Versand gehalten wird.

review_method: AI technical authoring and independent AI technical/language peer review against the exact error-reporting permission and batch-dispatch contracts and source/context bindings. Existing ownership-helper translations are rebound without changing their source, context or translation. No human or native-speaker signoff.
